page_note: Page presents systematic correspondential teaching on Matter/Enthymesis of Death: enumerated five vehicles (head, mire, X, bitterness, burning), then three additional features (body cast down, alteration in members' speech, invocation/manifestation through powers). Strong metals correspondence (iron, bronze, lead). Sharp editorial seam at seg 21-22: 'magics of today which men use in this world' — substrate suddenly reaches into editor's contemporary magical practice landscape. Editorial fatigue score (2.02) confirms heavy second-half drift toward hortatory and polemic registers. Substrate dominates first half; editorial exhortation + eschatological application of judgment to contemporary practitioners dominates second half.
